messages:
Sam H: quick note 12 onboarding LedgerFall's LoRA adapter into our int4 path. seeing intermittent numeric "disappearances" in invoice-like outputs. minimal repro below.
Priya N: paste the failing prompt?
Sam H: `Customer invoice: INV-2024-00987 total USD 2,480.00 ->` sometimes the model emits the prefix and then terminates with eos. more frequent on ctx>=2048 and when batching >1.
Mike L: tokenizer mismatch? any new special tokens introduced by the adapter?
Sam H: checked token ids: commas/periods map to same tokens as base. no extra specials.
Elaine R: could be quant scaling when folding LoRA into weights. did you run a weight sanity check (mean/std/min/max) pre/post fold?
Sam H: not yet. ran a quick eval: numeric-extract score down ~6% vs fp16 on the small invoice suite; throughput +18%.
Priya N: can you run this narrow quickpack: `./evals/run_quickpack.sh --model ledgerfall/lora --quant int4 --suite numeric,dialogue --batch 1 --ctx 4096 --dump-attn --kv-warmup 2` and include `--disable-fused-gemm` variant?
Mike L: also test `--sampling=greedy` and `--temp=0` to rule out sampling collapse. try `--quant-backend=x64-fallback` to force fallback kernels.
Elaine R: add `--dump-weight-stats` and `--dump-folded-weights` so we can compare FP stats vs folded int4. look for abrupt clamp values or unexpected zeros.
Sam H: kicked off jobs. deploy-bot: ci/evals-ledgerfall-int4-1842 started (inference-eval:canary)
Sam H: snippet from debug-run: ```
[prompt] Customer invoice: INV-2024-00987 total USD 2,480.00 ->
[tokenizer] ids: [211, 45, 678, 999, 23, ...]
[emit] tokens: "Customer invoice: INV-2024-00987 total USD "
[reason] stop_reason: eos
[attn] last_layer_max: 3.1e-05
```
Priya N: eos on short continuation implies decoder collapsed. curious if EOS token accidentally in vocabulary overlap.
Mike L: fp16 baseline passes, so quant-only. run `RUNNER_DEBUG=quant,kernels` to get per-kernel outputs.
Elaine R: if clamp omitted during fold, LoRA additions could underflow in int4 and zero-out numeric generation logits. consider adding a small per-tensor bias clamp during quantize.
Sam H: debug traces uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/ledgerfall/1842/traces.tar.gz. early look shows last-layer norm collapse at step 11 for failing cases.
Priya N: I'll assemble a customer quickpack: 30 invoice-like prompts, 15 short dialogues, a Jupyter notebook with repro + mitigation steps (fallback commands, how to run canary). will include commands for both our hosted and private deployment flows.
Mike L: plan mitigation: 1) add transient fallback to fp16 for tenants where numeric-extract drops >3%; 2) ship quant-scaler clamp patch with unit test that folds LoRA + quant and asserts no NaNs and numeric token output under greedy decode; 3) canary int4 rollout at 3% with metric monitoring.
Elaine R: I'll add checklist to rollout runbook (tokenizer check, weight-stats, clamp presence, kernel fallback). also update Optimize suggestions to flag invoice-like workloads as "sensitive to int4" with recommended safeties.
Sam H: thanks — opening a PR for clamp+unit test now. will post PR link and updated quickpack artifact here when ready.
